summary: The governing extension applies the original outcome-led pilot to routine source slices from the Unified Roadmap v3 open index after protected reviewed delivery. Existing owning issue and native PR supply current state without new issues, duplicate packets, returns, reducer views, repeated parent approvals or status projections solely for routine delivery. One accountable owner, one independent source review, relevant tests, final required CI and exact tested-versus-delivered correspondence remain. An idle reviewer must actually be activated with followup_task for the exact candidate; send_message alone does not start review. Canonical PR tooling must preserve admission metadata; automatic preservation requires its own qualification. The v3 operating section orders seven existing-owner priorities: authorized private maintainer and SC2 Checks-read access; separate unknown-reservation reconciliation with demonstrably independent admitted source jobs; cheap compiler/focused feedback before full CI; canonical metadata and active review; routine source extension; the first UTEL managed-parent to Python-callback to CAP-03 typed-store to owned-recipient journey with fault tests, while V3 components qualify only against their actual named consumer path; and an explicit assessment of enforced containment versus universal physical-copy proof. This assessment does not change the acceptance contract: cap65536, universal proof gate, fit-unproved and admission-false persist until a reviewed decision. Source preparation cannot establish a working provider, installation or runtime acceptance. Existing operation admission, distinct credentials, independent trust-boundary readback and all unknown reservations remain; original .103 is attempted-unknown/unreplayed and .104 held. Private source/evidence remains restricted. Savings measurement stays inconclusive without comparable effort coverage, and is not an activation gate. Recovery helper references use protected governing delivery as activation; incomplete automatic evidence requires a targeted read and explicit gap, never restored mandatory duplicate artifacts.
title: Extend outcome-led coordination to routine v3 source with seven priority unblockers
